docs: Team content: the heading, a description and an ordered list of one to twelve members. One object is valid in every team layout (two, three or four columns, plain or on cards).

description.docs: one paragraph under the heading; empty: none

members.docs: the people, in the order they are shown

id.docs: stable key of the member (the Codex entry id)

avatar.docs: address of the portrait; none: the placeholder

description.docs: the role or a short line about the member; empty: none
